name: Spiano Grancer
original_name: スピアーノ・グランセル
source: Despite her young age, Spiano is the principal of the academy and an elite of the administrative bureau. Though she may seem like a very serious person considering her status, Spiano is actually very sloppy and lazy when alone or at home, though she is quite competent when at work. Has eyes for nothing but sweets and [url=https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Sh%C5%8Dch%C5%AB]shouchuu[/url]. Spiano is forced to use a wheelchair because of a certain incident, though she isn't too inconvenienced by it.
